context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 毀損/百科/後編/運搬/ネック/選別/結びつける/招か

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、企業ブランド、毀損したら回復に時間かかる。
lines.en: Ren, a brand—once it's damaged, recovery takes time.
lines.style: Measured, matter-of-fact opening. Not lecturing—sharing accumulated knowledge. Steady pace. Weight behind each phrase, like he's seen this happen before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。社内の百科辞典的ナレッジ、整備中なんですね。
lines.en: Yes. We're building up an internal knowledge base—kind of like a company encyclopedia.
lines.style: Eager but careful. He's trying to show he understands the bigger picture. Quick pickup on the thought. Hopeful energy underneath, seeking approval.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロジェクトの後編、君にも参加してもらう。
lines.en: I'm going to have you join us for the second phase of the project.
lines.style: Clear, direct statement. Not asking—deciding. Warm underneath the firmness. A small pause before the announcement, like he's already made up his mind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 物流の運搬計画、興味深いです。
lines.en: The logistics and transport planning—that does sound interesting.
lines.style: Genuine interest breaking through careful politeness. Slight lift in tone. He means it. Quick tempo, almost thinking out loud.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 人材不足はネック。だが、適切な選別で乗り越える。
lines.en: Talent shortage is the bottleneck. But the right selection process will get us past it.
lines.style: Pragmatic, unflinching about the problem. No softening. But the solution lands with quiet confidence—he's done this calculation before. Slight emphasis on 'right'.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 業界の専門家と結びつける機会、勉強になります。
lines.en: Getting connected with people who really know this field—that's something I want to learn from.
lines.style: Respectful, genuinely grateful. He's recognizing the value being handed to him. Soft, thoughtful delivery. Slight formality in the register, showing respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今度の懇親会、君も招かれてる。
lines.en: You're invited to the social gathering coming up.
lines.style: Warm closing. A small smile underneath the words—this is an offer, an inclusion. Not a command. Gentle, almost inviting him into something bigger than just work.
